source_title: China demands copper supply commitments for Anglo Teck merger approval, sources say
quote: China's antitrust regulator has asked Anglo American (LON: AAL) to commit to supply the country with a steady flow of copper concentrate as a condition for approving its proposed $54 billion merger with Canada's Teck Resources (TSX: TECK.B), three people aware of the development said.

source_title: China demands copper supply commitments for Anglo Teck merger approval, sources say
quote: The demand reflects China's struggle to feed its vast copper smelting industry, which refines up to 60% of the world's copper cathodes but faces its worst feedstock shortage in decades.

source_title: China demands copper supply commitments for Anglo Teck merger approval, sources say
quote: China's State Administration for Market Regulation has asked for assurances on copper concentrate supply, including volumes sold through traders, said the people, who declined to be named due to the confidential nature of discussions.

source_title: China demands copper supply commitments for Anglo Teck merger approval, sources say
quote: Both companies expect the deal to close by March 2027, within 18 months from the announcement.

source_title: China demands copper supply commitments for Anglo Teck merger approval, sources say
quote: A combination would control around 5% of global copper supply, below competition thresholds exceeding 10% to 15%.

source_title: Shyam Metalics signs deal to invest over $5 billion in Maharashtra state
quote: India's Shyam Metalics and Energy (NSE: SHYAMMETL) on Friday said it has signed a deal with the Maharashtra government to invest 500 billion rupees ($5.19 billion) to set up a steel plant in the western state.

source_title: Shyam Metalics signs deal to invest over $5 billion in Maharashtra state
quote: The integrated metal producer will build a 9 million-metric-tonnes-per-year greenfield steel complex in Chandrapur in the state's Vidarbha region, the company said in an exchange filing.

source_title: Shyam Metalics signs deal to invest over $5 billion in Maharashtra state
quote: The steel plant is slated to begin operations in the ongoing financial year, subject to approvals, clearances and incentives.

source_title: South Korea indicts six petrochemical firms over W16.4 trillion price-fixing case – report
quote: SINGAPORE (ICIS)–South Korean prosecutors have indicted six petrochemical companies and 37 of their current and former executives and employees for allegedly fixing prices of products, including polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and plasticizers.
